children: Solar Industries and Astra Microwave are among the top defense companies benefiting from India's higher government spending and a push for private partnerships, Jefferies analysts Lavina Quadros and Shirom Kapur say. With the private-sector share rising in defense, the analysts estimate Solar and Astra's earnings will increase at compound annual growth rates of 31% and 19%, respectively, through FY2026-2030. Jefferies initiates coverage of the two with buy ratings and target prices of 28,160 rupees and 2,055 rupees, respectively. It also starts coverage of state-run Bharat Dynamics with a hold rating and target price of 1,280 rupees. (venkat.pr@wsj.com)
